method: Sequential fresh wiki creations through Special:CreateWiki; login and form preparation excluded. Provisioning completion observed every 500 ms.
timing_clock: Host monotonic duration; queue/start times use Redis stream/status timestamps, with legacy Docker volume file timestamps as fallback.
notes: Measured after Docker Desktop recovery: Linux virtual disk vda had I/O errors, filesystem was read-only, Redis returned MISCONF Errors writing to the AOF file: Read-only file system. Restarted Docker Desktop; Redis write, database health and provisioner health recovered before sampling. Timings from the storage-fault interval were not used.
Third sample follows 120 seconds without creation traffic. Background services remain running; this is not a forced cold-cache test or proof against longer-idle outliers.

SQL scopes measure client-observed query time, not all connection/network/cache work. Metadata/updater wall includes process launch and completion observation. Temporary SQL and milestone probes add some overhead.

The POST handler performs deferred work after fastcgi_finish_request; form_profile.wall_ms includes that work and must not be equated with browser POST response time. Form submission, deferred work and provisioning overlap.
Verified readiness includes the test observer polling every 500 ms and a subsequent API check; actual worker completion is separately recorded. Login and form preparation are excluded.
Original coordinator and LocalSettings were restored exactly; temporary helper files removed. Live code Watch was restarted after profiling.
